text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Aston
Machan
and I notice that a certain
corner of the shopping
district is
particularly busy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to get one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. There's a coupon for a hot
spring
vacation up for grabs.
choice_data_list: So you want to do it.
Do you want to do it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The dazzling inn, the delicious meals,
the hot
baths. Pillow fights, girl talk. A
hot spring
vacation makes for a treasure
trove of memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do I have the will to resist the
temptation? ...No,
I don't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So Aston Machan and I quickly procure
ourselves
a raffle ticket, and...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Here I go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan gives the raffle machine a
powerful
spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Wow.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yay! This is amazing! Yay for Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can invite Vodka and Scarlet, and we
can all go
on a revitalizing trip to the
hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm so sorry. This ticket is only for
two.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh. So that means we can't all go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...That makes things difficult.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Good idea. I'm sure one day I'll get a
chance to
use it.
choice_data_list: For now, why not put it away?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep it in my room. No, actually, I'll
put it in
your office.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. We can display it in a frame.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If we treat the coupon with care, we
won't lose it.
And it'll stay in mind as
long as it's in sight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That way, we'll make sure it doesn't go
to waste.
Perfect.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First, we need to go buy a big picture
frame!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, until the day we use it, we
decide to put
the hot spring vacation
coupon on display in my
office.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Aw... I was so close.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But this prize does look very tasty. And
it's
enormous as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Do you have any plans for dinner
tonight,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Munch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow. This is...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's revolutionary.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It makes me want to commemorate the
day... We
should remember this date as
Carrot Hamburger
Steak Day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Next year, too, this day can be
Carrot
Hamburger Steak Day. And the
year after as well.
When it comes
around, we'll eat carrot hamburger

steak, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then, before you know it, it'll
become a
tradition. A hundred years
from now, it'll be
documented in
textbooks.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They'll say that the creator of Carrot
Hamburger
Steak Day was none other
than the great and
glorious Aston
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, maybe that's going a little far.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy the deluxe carrot hamburger
steak
together while chatting about
various random
topics.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ooh... I didn't win the big one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But now we've got a whole bushel of
carrots.
What should we do with them?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you think the two of us could finish
them all?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I've got it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Aston Machan here. This is an
emergency
stream.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A carrot-related incident has occurred.
That's
right... We have too many carrots.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and I simply don't have space in
our
stomachs for all of them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This offer is exclusively for those
attending
Tracen Academy, but if
anyone is willing to lend
us their
stomach, we would be very grateful.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to help, make your way to
Machan's
room. We'll be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I later hear that a handful of
Umamusume who
caught wind of the
offer wolfed the carrots down
in an
instant.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh... The bronze prize.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the carrot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What should I do with this? I guess I
could have it
for dinner tonight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. How is it, Frosty Flops?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's yummy? Oh, good.

text_block_list.name: Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Haha, she's really digging into that
carrot. Thank
you, Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. I'm happy to see her
enjoying it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan plays with her fluffy little
friend
until the sun goes down.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ouch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So I lost? What a shame.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess failure makes for a funnier
story.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we could make it into a
four-panel comic?
That'll probably make
us feel better about losing
too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The first panel can show Machan excited
for the
lottery. Then, she spins the
tumbler in the second
panel.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In the third, she opens the capsule! And
in the last
panel, she's dabbing away her
tears with a tissue
because she won
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Reliving it has only made me feel
worse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan ends up shambling home
with a
somber gait...
